title: Beyond Adam: AI-Authored Discovery of Symbolic Optimization Rules

contributions.purpose: 设计紧凑可解释的优化器 DSL
contributions.mechanism: 离散 token 元组(βm,βv,a1,a2,p,η,ϵ)表示更新规则,SGD/Momentum/Adam 为特例
contributions.evaluation: 有限但可覆盖经典方法的符号空间,规则人类可读
contributions.domain: 符号优化器发现/AutoML/AI 自主科研
contributions.source_quote: our DSL is designed to capture classical methods (SGD, Momentum, Adam) as special cases while remaining fully discrete and interpretable

contributions.purpose: 演示 AI 端到端自主完成科研全流程
contributions.mechanism: (μ+λ) 进化搜索+精英+变异,DSL 设计/代码/实验/画图/写作全由 ChatGPT-5 agent 完成
contributions.source_quote: the entire research pipeline—from DSL design and evolutionary search through experiments, figure generation, and manuscript drafting—was conducted autonomously by the AI agent

contributions.evaluation: 演化规则"competitive"但基本重发现 SGD:Table 1 rastrigin evolved≡SGD=37.81(所有 budget),ackley 微优 7.72 vs 7.87
contributions.source_quote: the best evolved optimizers often resemble conservative SGD variants with partial momentum and variance tracking

self_declared_provenance.quote: Unlike prior work that used a small set of hand-picked primitives [3], our DSL is designed to capture classical methods (SGD, Momentum, Adam) as special cases while remaining fully discrete and interpretable.

notes: 具名作者 Robert Yang + ChatGPT-5(AI 一作)。自认核心贡献是"AI 端到端作者身份"而非优化器性能。诚实但含红旗:(1)负结果——演化规则基本只重发现 SGD(Table 1 rastrigin evolved≡SGD≡37.81 全 budget 相同;SGD 与 Momentum 数值完全相同也可疑);(2)显式循环自证——Section 7 承认"ChatGPT could use itself as both the experimenter and the experimentee";(3)AI 自我披露记忆污染——作者称 ChatGPT memory 里存的旧想法塑造了选题,且会议 context"polluted and skewed"选题偏向 meta;(4)不一致——Results 称"search was conducted solely on the Rastrigin landscape"与 Method 多 landscape 说法冲突。checklist 全 Yes 且人工核对,AI 披露 C/D/D/C;诚实局限(clipping/NaN guard 掩盖内在鲁棒性、未测神经网络)。accept。
